avis.texte: It gives you just the right amount of tingle. Feels refreshing and perfect for a little "wake me up" if needed. Not to mention, it always removes the last bit of dirt, even after a good face wash.

So i feel the efficacy of this product is contingent on personal skin goals. In my case, I tried this because im in my late 30's and have been struggling with hormonal acne, mostly on my chin/jawline area. This has not cleared up any of my acne, all it did was dry out my face. However, I feel that this toner would be great for a teen or someone who is just trying to control an oily face, not someone with active hormonal acne. Its definitely not for anyone whose skin is dry/combo because all it will do is strip the moisture from your skin. I use the acne exfoliating toner by Peach Slices now and it is much more effective for me.

I used to use witch hazel, but I switched to this toner about 10 years ago, after I read an article about Mally Roncal, who mentioned using it, and she has amazing, ageless skin. I have sensitive, aging, combination skin, but this toner just "clears the decks" without any over-drying or irritation, and makes it seems like I have great, balanced, healthy young skin. I am now in my mid-forties and people never think so, which leads them to ask what products I use on my skin and I always tell them: Mario Basdescu. I hope Ulta keeps selling it in stores and if you are on the fence, just go for it! (And if you are looking to pair it w/ a great moisturizer, I love Mario Badescu's oil free moisturizer with SPF 30 too.)
My skin is very sensitive to most toner type products and this works so good and actually calms any reactions.
This is the best toner for my extremely oily skin & nothing even comes close to this price point. I don't plan on ever using anything else.

avis.titre: Please put the big ones back on the shelf
avis.texte: I love this product. I use it as a toner. It gets dirt off without drying. I've been to several Ultas and they haven't been on the shelf. MB, please don't get rid of this.

At first I was very turned off because this product smells like a baby wipe, but it works really well! I have very oily skin and break out often. I've been using this for a week and have already noticed an improvement in my skin. Even though it has alcohol, I don't find it to be drying. I used to moisturize religiously at night but my skin doesn't feel dry or thirsty after using this so I've been slipping moisturizer for the most part. In the morning I use a hydrating primer and it's a perfect combo.

My husband and brother both struggle with occasional cystic back pimples, and then one appeared on my back the other day after switching birth control brands. For years, had used this cleaning lotion as a facial toner after washing my face in the shower. I gave it a go on my back and décolletage in attempts to remedy my bacne pimple— the next day it was gone! I told my husband and brother immediately and they are sold for life now, too! My husband's back has never looked and felt so smooth and beautiful. When I asked about his results, my brother called it "alchemy," a "miracle cure." It's fab for the face, too.

avis.titre: I will forever use this produce!
avis.texte: I have tried multiple toners in my life and NONE compare to this! Will forever be my favorite 🤩
I use this product along with some other Mario Badescu products and it works wonders on my skin. I love the scent, it doesn't burn or irritate my face in any way.
I use this once a day and after applying Badescu's Witch Hazel and Lavender toner. My skin feels so smooth, and I've only used it for less than a week.

avis.titre: IN MY BASIC BEAUTY ROTATION FOR YEARS!
avis.texte: I use a number of products on my facial skin each day including a moderate coverage foundation. This removes every last vestige of product from my skin, even after thorough cleansing.
I have super dry sensitive skin with horrendously bad hormonal acne. This product is my new holy grail — got rid of almost everything.
This is my go-to after a workout or just to freshen my face without doing a full face wash. PSA: I never got a break out from this! (Which says a lot because everything makes me break out!)

NO THANK YOU! Used this once and its horrible. It has zero benificial ingredients and has a lot of parfum. The smell is super disgusting and overpowering. It didn't cleanse my skin at all it felt like nothing. A couple minutes later my skin was red and burning. Horrible product don't waste your money. Just dont but it.

I've been using this product for about a year and a half now and cannot get enough of it. I change my skincare routine quite a lot but this is always a part of it- nothing gets my skin feeling as clean without drying it out as this does. It smells lovely and is a great step after a heavier cleanser and before moisturizer (or even as a cleanser on its own for those lazy days!) About to purchase my fourth bottle, I cannot recommend this product enough and I can almost guarantee it will be friendly to all skin types.

This product is mostly alcohol, which I am just now learning is awful for your skin! It might feel like it is sucking up the excess oil in the beginning, but I've been using this for about a month now and my painful cystic acne in my T zone is only getting worse. After doing some research on ingredients I've now learned that alcohol only exacerbates oil production in the long run and makes acne worse. While this product feels like it's working (leaves skin feeling tight and clean), it's going to cause issues down the line. I wouldn't use this product with any skin type! Not good all around.
Smells very strong. As soon as I put it on my face, I broke out.
I love this product and have been using it for years! I love buying it in the larger format because I use it twice a day. My skin feels so refreshed and clean afterwards.
I use it as a quick cleanse when I get home to remove make up or after exercise. Get me by before I wash my face with actual face wash before bed. No effect on my skin noticed otherwise.

I bought the travel size cleanser, moisturizer and toner to try it out first. So far I'm loving all of the products! They leave my face feeling so soft and smooth! I have combo to oily skin. This works wonders!

I used it as a toner after my cleanser and it didn't do anything for me. My blackheads started to appear after changing from my previous toner to this one. My skin started to texturize after a while. Could just be my skin! Has a great scent though!

I don't use this as part of my regular skin routine, but rather as a cleanser when I'm too tired or don't have time to fully wash my face. It doesn't dry my skin out, so I typically just use my lightest moisturizer afterwards. My only issue is that it goes really fast, even when I'm not using it every day. I run out of this faster than I do products I use daily, so I'm always torn about repurchasing.

I've use this product for about a week now and the acne cleanser gel and I have noticed a huge difference in my skin. I'm usually not a fan of cucumber scents but I really like this one! I have acne and illy skin.
It's so refreshing, hydrating, and light on my sensitive skin. It reduces redness in my skin tone but it doesn't completely prevent breakouts. It's great at cleaning out excess dirt in my face!

This is my go to toner when Im not using micellar water as a second step cleanser. It smells amazing, it doesnt make my skin feel tight, and it soothes my skin without causing breakouts. A lot of people dislike the fact that it has alcohol in it, I have yet to notice any drying effects caused by the alcohol in this particular product.

I'm 54 and still have acne, Mario Badescu's products are amazing. What is great about the Cucumber Lotion is it's gentle . . ..cleans deep, but non-burning and non drying. I have oily skin, and this lotion really helps.

Seriously: I used to break out sooooo much, like I would have lots of pimples all over my cheeks and chin and T-zone, but ever since I stared using this along with the Enzyme Cleansing Gel, I never break out. Words can't describe how satisfied I am with this product; I 10/10 recommend this to everyone with oily skin like mine😭💕

wow! I love this stuff! I know it's suppose to be used mainly as a toner, but whenever I feel myself about to break out, I place this stuff on it and the next night it is smaller or non-existent!!! I've bought two bottles already!!!

So I'd ran out of face wash recently and was unsure which face wash to switch to, as mine had been drying skin out so bad with the weather getting colder. I picked this up because I love their facial spray, and I knew this particular brand is pretty good with sensitive skin. All I can say is wow. My face has cleared up in a week, and my skin is soooo much softer and smoother. My boyfriend even noticed how smooth my skin looks all the sudden. Love this product, and all others by this brand.

this toner is great it helped my skin when it was really irritated and textured. however if i use it ever time i wash my face it does get a little drying so i would recommend using it once a day instead of the 2x a day instructions on the bottle
I love this toner. It smells so nice, it doesn't burn and leaves my skin feeling refreshed and dewy

avis.titre: Great Cleanser - Take off heavy makeup first though
avis.texte: Love this cleanser. Does not leave skin dry or greasy, just normal! Even though it doesn't foam up, I use it in the shower on very wet skin and it does a great job of cleansing. This is my go-to morning cleanser. The only exception is that it does not remove heavy foundation or eye makeup 100%. Most non-drying cleansers don't. The toner will pick that up (except eye area) or I use a makeup removing cleanser such as Clinique Rinse Off Foaming cleanser first.
I used the product a few times and I started to notice my skin was a lot drier and I normally have oily skin. I saw that it contains alcohol and I also try to stay away from that.

It's an okay cleanser but I will not be repurchasing. I've noticed no improvements in my skin and I've used it for over 6 months not to mention it doesn't lather and it doesn't feel as if it cleans very well.

I have always heard great things about this brand, so I decided to finally try some out. I was SUPER disappointed when I opened this and it smelled like straight up isopropyl alcohol. Sure enough it's the 2nd ingredient, after water. I gave it a try anyway, and my skin reacted as if I had used rubbing alcohol. Bummer.

I tried this with the oily skin regimen kit. I was disappointed when I tried it because it contains alcohol, which is just not ideal for my skin and it smells bad. It ended up working fine after a few weeks of use but I liked my old Dr. Thayers witch hazel toner better and its much cheaper. I bought full sized bottles of everything in the oily skin regimen but this. Overall not a bad toner it just doesnt work for me. I would not buy this if you have dry or sensitive skin.

I love this product!!! I have super dry skin and was scared this product would dry my skin out more if used regularly. I received a sample of this and began using it at nights for about a week and a half and oh wow my skin felt so clean! I always took off my makeup and then used this applying with a cotton pad and I was amazed by how much makeup and dirt it still took off of my face. This does make your skin feel very dried out but if you follow it with a moisturizer or lotion (I used pond's moisturizing cream) then it doesn't leave any long term dryness! I've noticed my skin be so much clearer since I started using this and I've actually repurchased it 3 times since I originally had the sample. I cannot recommend this product enough!!!!!
This may be good for a super oily skin, but I'm normal to oily and with the second ingredient being Isopropyl Alcohol I think it's just too drying for my skin in particular.
Smells great but irritated my skin. I do have sensitive skin but wanted to give it try since it said it can be used for all skin types

avis.titre: I like it okay but.. it contains alcohol.
avis.texte: I really wish this toner didnt contain alcohol. It feels great but I will be sticking to my seaweed toner for daily use. I'll use this once in a while just because I do love it and small amounts of alcohol aren't bad for you skin.
I have 2 backups already. I vow to never run out. I use this everyday and night. It is not too strong, smells amazing and always cleans the tiny bit of makeup that I may have missed

If you are considering buying this product please don't hesitate. It's absolutely amazing. After using this product for a over month I can simply say my skin care routine has forever changed. My skin has never looked better. < 3

avis.titre: I will but this product repeatedly

i love this toner! i have repurchased at least 3 times and i always get the biggest bottle. i feel like it just cleans a little more after washing your face and balances out your face. i would say this is okay for sensitive skin. doesn't leave my skin feeling dry at all.

I love this product! My favorite out of all their products. I use this after my daily moisturizer and it says to use with a pad but I just drip it onto my face and rub it in. My face is glowy and super smooth/soft I have been using it for about a month and I'm only a quarter way through the travel sized bottle!

All I want to do is ice my face. I've never had issues with being sensitive and have always had pretty good clear skin. This just hurts.

This is a great exfoliating, gentle astringent. I use it with the glycolic enzyme wash and the oil free lotion from MB. It's terrific for oily skin/acne prone w dry patches. It has been a miracle for me. I recommend using all three products for best results. My acne is gone and my skin is feeling great after 7 days.

I have combo-dry skin (tried this out during the winter/colder months) it works – removed the grime off my face (used it in the morning as a toner). However, after a few weeks I noticed my skin had become drier (most likely due to the alcohol) . Would recommend to people with oiler skin.

For some crazy reason, after several years of Neutrogena use I thought I should shop around for a new skin care line. I researched for a natural product and found Mario Badescu. I had a sample of their glycolic cleanser and liked it and so bought the other products. This is a is a liquid like a toner, and not a lotion.. I never felt like my skin was clean! after about 10 days, I developed what looked like tiny white heads on all my pores!! Plus, I began to have breakouts, which I had rarely experienced before. I would not consider this product again -- I am back to Neutrogena.

I have oily skin but this was not for me, I honestly don't know who would be able to use this on their skin. Might work for removing nail polish or something.
I got a sample of this stuff and it smells terrible. It also really irritated my skin but luckily I only put it on my neck and not my face.

avis.titre: I love this skin care line!!!!
avis.texte: I love this product line. It is by far the best I have ever used. It smells great and my skin feels clean and soft. It is reasonably priced but feels like you are using high end spa products. I will never use anything else.

I've been using this for about a week now and I have the worst oily skin ever. I use it every night not so much in the morning but it takes away almost all of the oils on my face. it's amazing and feels so good the scent is kinda strong but it works so good

avis.titre: I love this never knew I was a dirty girl until this
avis.texte: It gets all the gunk left after you use makeup wipes but it might affect sensitive skin in the wrong way

I love the smell of this so much as does my husband he thinks it smells like baby powder but the results I have gotten our amazing my skin feels so good when I apply this product and the redness on my cheeks definitely tones down a lot I had bought the 8 ounce bottle and when I run out I will probably buy the 16 ounce!
I use this product after cleasing my face with the Enzyme cleansing gel. I am still testing it. There's nothing that I don't like or like. I'm still trying it out.

I got a sample of this in their "combo skin" trial/travel size box so I could try out some of their products before buying a bigger size. This product is my all time favorite! My face tends to get oily easily, especially on my nose and the tops of my cheeks. After using this every morning and night, I've noticed that it takes so much longer for my face to get oily. I also ran out of this product and my face was not happy that I wasn't using this anymore and I broke out all over. This product is a life changer!!

My friend gave me a sample bottle of Mario Badescu's rosewater spray and it did wonders so I decided to try this toner as a suggestion from a brand representative in the Ulta store. Where has this toner been all my life?!! I absolutely LOVE this toner. I never go a day without using it. I even bought it on an overnight trip just because I was afraid if I didn't bring it, my skin would suffer. I had severely oily acne-prone skin and over the past 2 years, it has transitioned into being less acne-prone and combo oily in the my t-zone. I had been dealing with dryness and figured it would help. Since using this, I have had significant reduction in dryness on my face, I have had less breakouts, my skin glows, it feels softer and there are times where it moisturizes so well that I can skip my moisturizer . I sweat a lot and my face still glows from within when I'm sweaty. I don't buy expensive products but I don't care how much it costs, I will buy this toner over and over. It is literally the best facial product I could have purchased. If you're debating, just buy it. You will not regret it.

I use this after I take my makeup off before I go to sleep and when I wake up before I put more makeup on. It has improved my skin texture (previously bumpy) and leaves my skin feeling tight and super clean. The smell is a bit strong at first, but I highly recommend if you have combination to oily skin for toning.

avis.titre: This toner has truly changed my skin for the better! Love it

First tested this as a sample, I loved it and had great results so I bought a full bottle. Refreshing, balances skin and controls my shiny t zone!
I absolutely LOVE this brand. I started using it about 2 months ago and already see such a difference in my skin. My pores have become smaller, skin looks brigther and feels clean.
Love this toner! It cleans your face so well and it leaves your skin feeling clean and refreshed. Love the smell also. Great for using under a serum or moisturizer
I have EXTREMELY oily/ sensitive skin, and this was amazing! I couldn't say enough good things about it!!

I've been using MB products for about six months now and live the way my skin has been looking and feeling. Lately I've been using the Glycolic Acid Toner but it is a little strong. I got this recommendation from a store associate and I love it! It does a great job and leaves my skin feeling fresh and soft.

I have skin that likes to surprise me everyday with oily, dry, acne filled, or combo skin. It truly is a mystery what I am going to get everyday. I use the philosophy purity face wash, then this on a cotton ball, and during the day the honey moisturizer and at night the seaweed cream. I am in love. This stuff takes off all of the extra dirt and grime that's left over even after a face wipe and scrubbing with soap. My cotton pad will be filled with all that gunk left over (gross I know). I will buy this again and again. It keeps my skin feeling soft, healthy, clean, and more even. My skin feels more on the normal side since using this. No breakouts, no excessive oil, no dry patches, just clear and soft skin. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!
I use this product every day of my daily regimen. I am 18 weeks pregnant and I normally have breakouts when I do but so far my face is still clear...

avis.titre: This is the only product I've found that I like!
avis.texte: I use the product once in the morning and once before bed. Works wonderfully. Going to buy the wash this week!

Works really well with my skin. I've aged and with hormonal changes...my skin is much more oily than before. It helped reduced the look of my acne scars as well. My before uses it as well and it works for him too. I will be buying more. I wish they carry a travel size version.
It makes my skin feel and look great, it smells incredible too!

avis.titre: I am in love with Product, took away all of my texture !

My t-zone was also not as shiny when I used this. It does contain alcohol but feels gentle on the skin.

I've been using this toner for about a year and I have mixed feelings about it. So the product itself works great, it also lasts forever (im only half way through the 8oz), but I don't like that isopropyl alcohol is an ingredient, especially listed so high, since it isn't a good ingredient. The thing is, I feel like this has really helped with my skin, considering I breakout so much less when I use this toner. It works really well, I just don't think I'll repurchase after I finish it because of the isopropyl alcohol.

I really loved this product and what it was doing for my skin but alcohol is way too high on that ingredient list for me. I am a huge fan of Mario Badescu products (I even get my facials done at the salon in NY). So I switched from this toner to the Alpha Grapefruit one which I am also loving.
not for oily skin, I stopped having breakouts for months until I started using this product
It takes off dead skin and left over make up. You can even put it on your neck and it will still take off dead skin and dirt too!

I really like using this after I was my face in the mornings before my makeup application. It helps to remove any excess oil and balance my skin. Its very refreshing. What i dont like is the smell. It has a strong alcohol smell. I gave 4 stars because of the strong smell

avis.titre: So I was considering buying this until....
avis.texte: SO I was considering buying this, I love the brand. I am an auto tech major and as through my knowledge Propylene Glycol is a type of coolant. Yes, I said coolant. Propylene Glycol is listed as the third ingredient in generally all the brands products. This is an irratant to your skin.

This product has alcohol, which is terrible for your skin when used daily! It dries out your skin to the point where ur skin feels the need produce more oil to compensate. I developed terrible under the skin acne that pained like crazy and left horrible scar. On my quest for clear skin this one was a MAJOR setback. I wouldn't recommend this for anyone. It smells nice (cucumber scent) but that doesn't make up for a terrible reaction it gave me. Never again!!!!

I love this stuff!! I have bought it twice now (with the cleaner) and they both work great. I love the hint of cucumber it has. It makes my skin feel super clean and refreshed. I also love how affordable this product is!! You won't be disappointed!! This actually has brightened up my skin a significant amount and ever since I​ started a daily skin routine with these products I've never broken out again!!!
This is my holy grail. I'm on bottle number 5 or 6 and I don't anticipate I will ever switch. Cleanses and refreshes my skin and helps prevent breakouts. Love this!!
I read previous reviews on this product & decided to try it. I have used this for not even a week & have noticed a huge improvement in my skin. I definitely will continue to use this!
This product is amazing I use it morning and night after cleansing my face. It removes the left behind makeup leaves you feeling clean and refreshed! And it smells great!!

This product was ok in its effects on my skin and my acne. It worked well enough but I found that my face was just too dry throughout the day. I normally have an oily face, so I seek products that help matte my face. This product was almost too much with that effect. I think it may be due to the amount of alcohol in the product. There is a very strong alcohol scent while applying.
I love this product... I will Be buying the rest of the products as well

As for the formula, it's very refreshing and detoxifying. I can truly say that my skin feels cleansed after using this. It is geared more toward oily skin, so I can't say that it helped the texture of my dry skin - astringents aren't supposed to be hydrating anyway - but after multiple uses, I did notice an improvement in my acne. Really excited to keep using this product!

This is one of the best "toners" or after-cleansing products I've every used. So many of them contain alcohol or other drying agents that can burn or irritate skin and dry out your face. This does NOT. I am in my late 50's and still have very oily skin. Trying to find a product that will keep the oil in check without creating more wrinkles is a challenge to say the least!!! This stuff makes my face feel soft and clean without feeling dry or stinging. Usually I have trouble with dry patches in the winter - but not since I started using this. Love it!
Received a sample of this and will never use it again. Alcohol is the second ingredient and the alcohol smell is overwhelming. Incredibly drying too. Better off with alcohol free witch hazel

I got a free sample of this and love it. I used a cotton round to wipe my face with it after my normal routine. The amount of makeup that still came off was a bit shocking. Changing foundation and buying a bunch of this! Also love this is a cruelty free brand.

I love this product and use it religiously since I found it. It makes my skin feel, look and smell great and I have seen great improvement to my skin because of it.
